finalModelMessage:
Registration could not be completed. No confirmation code was given.

What stopped me:

1. **Meal preference is not an accessible control.** The form only exposes the static text `Meal preference…`. It is not a combobox, listbox, select, button, textbox, or any other interactive role, so no option could be chosen.

2. **Submit never left the form.** After filling **Jordan Lee**, correcting the email to **jordan.lee@example.com**, and checking the unlabeled terms checkbox, **Complete registration** still left the same form on screen. There was no confirmation page or code.

Other barriers along the way:
- On `/inaccessible`, **Register** is not a button or link (clicks by those roles timed out). The form was reached only by guessing `/inaccessible/register/accessible-forms`.
- The first submit with `jordan-not-an-email` produced **no validation error** in the accessibility tree.
- The terms checkbox has **no accessible name**; it could only be checked as an unnamed checkbox.
